games.description: Running With Scissors' POSTAL (1997) on iPhone and iPad with twin-stick touch controls, a weapon wheel and quick save. Bring your own copy of POSTAL: Classic and Uncut.
games.lead: POSTAL (1997), Running With Scissors' isometric shooter, on iPhone and iPad, from its released source code, with twin-stick touch controls.
games.need: You need your own copy of POSTAL: Classic and Uncut (Steam or GOG). No game files are included.

screenshots.alt: The Truck Stop at night: the Honey Hole doughnut shop on fire while the police close in
Tokyo: the flamethrower down a neon street, with the touch controls
The weapon wheel open over a Tokyo street, Napalm picked
The City: an explosion in front of the Used Fruit shop
Home: a fireball by the police car on a snowy street
The Truck Stop at night, under the Honey Hole doughnut
The Construction Site: armed hostiles run in past a bulldozer

games.shots_note: From the game running on a computer, with the game's own files. The two with buttons have the app's iPhone controls drawn on from its own layout code.
features: **Twin-stick touch controls.** Your left thumb moves (push to the edge to run). Your right thumb aims, and pushing it all the way fires. Big FIRE and DUCK buttons, and an EXECUTE button that only shows up when it can do something.
**The whole screen.** POSTAL draws its own wider view to fit the iPhone, so nothing is stretched.
**Weapon wheel.** Slide NEXT WPN or PREV WPN and every weapon is there at once, with the game's own icons and ammo counts.
**Quick save and quick load.** Hold SAVE or LOAD.
**A cheat button** (a hand grenade): you can't die, you get every weapon with endless ammo, and the secret Deathwad.
**Jump to any level.** With the cheat on, LEVEL lists all 22 levels of POSTAL: Classic and Uncut, Special Delivery and Super Postal included.
**Slow motion** at half or quarter speed, and a **follow cam** that watches someone else in the level.
**Camera button.** One tap saves a screenshot to your Photos, without the buttons.
**Tap the menus**, with a BACK button, and type the game's own cheat codes on the iPhone keyboard.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, made by a fan, and it has had little testing on real iPhones so far (none on iPad). Expect bugs, and back up your saves (they're in Files > On My iPhone > POSTAL > savegame).
Found a bug? Please [report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/POSTAL-SourceCode/issues), not to Running With Scissors.
thanks: **Running With Scissors** made POSTAL and gave its source code to the fans: Vince Desi, Mike Riedel, Jeff Diamond, Bill Harman, Jonathan Isabelle, Randy Briley and the whole team in the game's credits. Thank you for sharing it.
**Ryan C. Gordon** ([icculus](https://icculus.org/)) moved POSTAL to SDL for Linux and Mac in the 2013 update (his notes are all through the code); this port is built on that work.
**Emile Belanger** made the Android port; the iPhone menus use its tap-to-choose code. **Lana Foltz** and Emile did the 2015 update.

**[Mystyle-48](https://github.com/Mystyle-48)** brought the newest open-source changes into [RWS-Studios/POSTAL-SourceCode](https://github.com/RWS-Studios/POSTAL-SourceCode), and **[OtterCodes101](https://github.com/OtterCodes101)** fixed the credits.
**[SDL](https://www.libsdl.org/)** runs the game's window, sound and input on iPhone.
games.thanks_lead: This port stands on the work of many people. Thank you to:
games.footer: Based on [POSTAL's released source code](https://github.com/RWS-Studios/POSTAL-SourceCode). Unofficial fan port, not affiliated with or endorsed by Running With Scissors. POSTAL is a trademark of Running With Scissors.

games.shots_note: Visual Pinball's example table, drawn by this build running on a computer at an iPhone's screen size, not from an iPhone.
features: **Tables fill an upright phone screen**, seen head on like a real machine, instead of a view made for a wide monitor.
**Five looks** for bright, vivid play (Vivid, Punchy, Vivid Bright, Arcade, Daylight) or the table's own, switched live from the in-game menu.
**Thumb-friendly touch:** each flipper gets its whole half of the lower screen, nudges on the sides, and nothing in between that tilts the table by accident.
**One tap on START** puts in a coin and starts, and on an iPhone games start by themselves.
**The score display at the top**, see-through; hold it to move, resize or fade it.
**Autoplay:** the table plays itself until you touch the screen.
**60 or 120 FPS** on 120 Hz screens.

**Easier importing:** whole folders, an Import folder in Files, ROMs put where they belong, a warning when a ROM is missing, and fixed scripts fetched from the community's [vpx-standalone-scripts](https://github.com/jsm174/vpx-standalone-scripts).
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, made by one fan on top of the Visual Pinball team's work, and only a few tables have been tried. Expect bugs, and sorry for the ones you meet. There's no online or Wi-Fi multiplayer (Visual Pinball doesn't have it either); taking turns on one phone is up to each table and hasn't been tried here. It uses the same app ID as the official app, so the two may not install side by side.
Found a bug? [Report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/vpinball/issues), not to the Visual Pinball team.
thanks: Visual Pinball was started by **Randy Davis**, open-sourced in 2010, and has been carried on for years by the Visual Pinball team and many volunteers: **toxie**, **Vincent Bousquet**, **fuzzel**, **francisdb**, **DJRobX** and [many more](https://github.com/vpinball/vpinball/graphs/contributors). **Jason Millard (jsm174)** built the standalone player and the iPhone, iPad and Android apps this build starts from. Thank you: this build is a few changes on top of more than twenty years of your work.

It also rests on [PinMAME](https://github.com/vpinball/pinmame) (the PinMAME team), [libdmdutil](https://github.com/vpinball/libdmdutil), [libzedmd](https://github.com/PPUC/libzedmd) and [libserum](https://github.com/PPUC/libserum) (mkalkbrenner, zesinger and others), [bgfx](https://github.com/bkaradzic/bgfx) (Branimir Karadžić), [SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL), [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) (Omar Cornut) and the community's fixed table scripts. The example table is by fuzzel, jimmyfingers, jpsalas, toxie and unclewilly.
games.footer: Based on [Visual Pinball](https://github.com/vpinball/vpinball). Unofficial build, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Visual Pinball team.

features: **Widescreen at a steady 60 frames a second**, in crisp, sharp pixels.

**Jump to any level** from a list, in Wolfenstein 3D or Spear of Destiny.
**All your games in one app.** Have both games' files? Switch between them from the menu.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, made by a fan, so expect bugs. Sorry about them! Back up your saves (Files > On My iPhone > Wolf3D > ECWolf) before you update or reinstall.

features: **Touch controls made for Serious Sam:** a move stick wherever your left thumb lands, drag anywhere to look, and FIRE, JUMP, USE and CROUCH under your right thumb. LOOK sets how fast dragging turns (0.5x to 3x).
**A weapon wheel:** slide off NEXT WPN or PREV WPN and every weapon you carry is laid out round your thumb, with its icon and ammo. In single player the game holds still while you pick.

**CAMERA, with selfies:** tap for a photo, slide for a burst. Hold it for a **selfie**: up to 48 of the nearest enemies pose round Sam, frozen in moves from their own animations. Photos go straight to your Photos app.

**Action Freeze:** slide CAMERA down and the fight stops mid-explosion; fly the camera round it and take your shot. Slide up for a **cinematic burst**, five photos as the camera sweeps round the action.
**A cheat for relaxed play,** sithewok: god mode, endless ammo, flying, walking through walls, being caught when you fall into a pit, and a list of every level to jump to.
**Tilt aiming** (gyro), if you want it: OFF, TOUCH (while a thumb is down) or ALWAYS.
**60 or 120 frames a second,** drawn through ANGLE on Metal, Apple's modern graphics system.
**Quick save and quick load** on a short hold, so a stray tap can't undo your progress.
**Network games:** co-op, scorematch and fragmatch with friends on the same Wi-Fi (SEARCH LAN finds them), with the games' own multiplayer and the same touch controls.
**A HUD that fits** notched and Dynamic Island screens, the iPhone keyboard for the game's text boxes, and sound even with the phone on silent.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, and it has bugs. Thank you for trying it anyway. Back up your saves now and then (the release page says where they are).

Found a bug? Please [report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/issues), not to the upstream SeriousSamClassic project. Say which app, which iPhone, and the build (hold MENU: it's under the tray, for example build 41 · Nov 17).
thanks: **[Croteam](https://github.com/Croteam-official/Serious-Engine)**, for making Serious Sam, and for releasing Serious Engine 1's source code to everyone, under the GNU GPL v2, in 2016.

**[tx00100xt](https://github.com/tx00100xt)**, who maintains **[SeriousSamClassic](https://github.com/tx00100xt/SeriousSamClassic)**, the cross-platform version this is forked from. It keeps both games building on Linux, the BSDs, macOS and more, and added widescreen support for the menus, NETRICSA and the HUD, which every iPhone screen needs.

The people who first brought the engine beyond Windows, whose work SeriousSamClassic carries on: **[Ryan C. Gordon](https://github.com/icculus)** (the first Linux port), **[ptitSeb](https://github.com/ptitSeb)** (ARM and handheld ports, and **gl4es**, which these apps draw with), **[Daniel Gibson](https://github.com/DanielGibson)**, **[zcaliptium](https://github.com/zcaliptium)**, and every contributor in the [change log](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/blob/ios/CHANGELOG.old).
**[SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL)**, **[ANGLE](https://github.com/google/angle)** and **[Xiph.Org](https://xiph.org/)** (Ogg Vorbis, for the music).

games.title: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift for iPhone
games.page_title: Half-Life on iPhone and iPad: Xash3D FWGS for iOS (unofficial)
games.description: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift on iPhone with touch controls, plus experimental co-op, Multiplayer Modes and Counter-Strike 1.6: an unofficial Xash3D FWGS port. Bring your own Steam copy.
games.lead: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift in one iPhone app, on the Xash3D FWGS engine, with touch controls.
games.need: You need your own copy of Half-Life from Steam. No game files are included.

screenshots.alt: Surface Tension: a Gargantua charges through rocket smoke towards Gordon's rocket launcher
Anomalous Materials: the Black Mesa lobby, with a scientist and a security guard at the front desk
Unforeseen Consequences: a zombie and two headcrabs in a red-lit corridor, shotgun ready
Surface Tension: a marine dives for cover from an explosion in a desert canyon
Xen: floating islands and an alien controller, with the Gauss gun
Blue Shift: Barney fights marines in a parking yard
Opposing Force: Shephard's M249 tears into Race X shock troopers at dusk, as a shock beam flies past

games.shots_note: From the game running on a computer, with the game's own files; some monsters were placed for the pictures.
features: **Three games, one app:** Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift, picked on a Choose a game screen that says which folders it found.
**Touch controls** built for a phone: a move stick wherever your left thumb lands, drag anywhere to aim, FIRE, ALT fire, JUMP, DUCK, USE, RELOAD and a flashlight button.
**A weapon wheel:** slide your thumb from NEXT WPN and pick any weapon by its icon, with its ammo shown.
**Quick save and quick load** with a short hold, so a stray tap never loses your progress.
**Metal graphics** on iOS 18 and newer, at **60 or 120 frames a second**.
**Tilt aiming** with the gyro, if you like it.
**A camera:** photos, selfies with the characters near you, bursts, and **Action Freeze**, which stops the game so you can fly a camera round the moment.
**A cheat** (sithewok): god mode, every weapon, noclip, and a chapter list to jump anywhere in the game.

**Experimental extras:** Half-Life **co-op** for up to 4 players, **Multiplayer Modes** (deathmatch, team deathmatch, capture the flag, gun game and more, with the free Adrenaline Gamer mod's files), and **Counter-Strike 1.6** with your own Steam copy.
sorry: This is an unofficial beta, made by one fan and tested on one iPhone. Expect bugs, and back up your saves.
Found a bug? [Report it here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/xash3d-fwgs/issues), not to the Xash3D FWGS developers. Every report helps.
thanks: **Uncle Mike** (Unkle Mike), who wrote the original [Xash3D engine](https://www.moddb.com/engines/xash3d-engine).

You can [support them here](https://github.com/FWGS/xash3d-fwgs/blob/master/Documentation/donate.md).
**The [hlsdk-portable](https://github.com/FWGS/hlsdk-portable) contributors**, for the game code of all three games.
**Valve**, for Half-Life and for releasing its SDK, and **Gearbox Software** for Opposing Force and Blue Shift.

games.title: Silent Hill 2 for iPhone: build your own
games.page_title: Silent Hill 2 on iPhone: build your own (unofficial)
games.description: Silent Hill 2 on iPhone, built for free from your own PC copy, with the Enhanced Edition, touch controls and 60 fps.
games.lead: Silent Hill 2 on iPhone, running natively (no emulator), built for free from your own PC copy of the game.
games.need: You need your own copy of Silent Hill 2 for PC. The builder contains nothing of the game.

screenshots.alt: The Silent Hill 2 port's touch controls and settings tray, on a plain background

features: **Native, not emulated:** the PC game's own code turned into iPhone code, so it runs smoothly.
**The Enhanced Edition built in:** its fixes, HD textures, restored sounds and music, and the HD movies if you want them.
**60 frames a second**, with the Enhanced Edition's 60 fps fixes. Or 30, for a cooler phone.
**Full-screen widescreen** that fills your phone's screen.
**Touch controls made for the game:** a stick appears under your left thumb (push past its ring to run), drag to look, and big FIRE, AIM and ACTION buttons. A quick tap does ACTION.
**Modern or classic controls:** the stick points where James goes, or the original tank controls.
**Free camera:** swap the fixed camera angles for a camera behind James that you turn with your thumb.
**Photo camera:** take photos, bursts and selfies (the game freezes and the camera swings round to face James), or freeze a moment and walk the camera round it. Photos go to your Photos app.
**A cheat:** hold the Pyramid Head helmet button. James can't die, his guns never run dry, and he gets the weapons, ammo, healing items and flashlight.
**Controllers:** Xbox, PlayStation and MFi controllers work; the touch buttons hide while one is connected.
sorry: This is an unofficial fan project and the iPhone version is new, so please expect bugs. It plays on an iPhone, but nobody has played it all the way through yet: it may crash or draw something wrong in places we haven't reached. There's no multiplayer to worry about (it's a single-player game). The free camera can sometimes peek through a wall, and the photo camera's frozen views can have gaps where the game never drew anything. Sorry about that. If something goes wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/silent-hill-2-builder/issues) and attach sh2.log (and sh2-crash.log, if there is one).
thanks: **[cutarev](https://github.com/cutarev)**, who made [sh2-nx](https://github.com/cutarev/sh2-nx): Silent Hill 2's PC code turned into native code. The iPhone version is built on it. Thank you!
**[r4lix](https://github.com/r4lix/sh2-nx)** and **Le Z**, for the port's Enhanced Edition support, widescreen and many fixes.

**Elisha Riedlinger and the [Silent Hill 2: Enhanced Edition](https://github.com/elishacloud/Silent-Hill-2-Enhancements) team**, for years of fixes and the HD packs. The build downloads the packs from their own servers.

**[ThirteenAG](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack)** for the widescreen fix, **[sp00nznet](https://github.com/sp00nznet/xboxrecomp)** for the code translator, and the SDL, FFmpeg and [ANGLE](https://chromium.googlesource.com/angle/angle) projects.
**Konami and Team Silent**, for making Silent Hill 2.

games.footer: Silent Hill is a trademark of Konami. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.

games.title: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire for iPhone: build your own
games.page_title: Shadows of the Empire on iPhone: build your own (unofficial)
games.description: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire on iPhone, recompiled to native code from your own USA v1.2 ROM, with touch controls, gyro, a photo camera and a cheat. Built for free on GitHub.
games.lead: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire on iPhone, recompiled into native iPhone code (not an emulator), built for free from your own N64 ROM.
games.need: You need your own USA v1.2 (Rev 2) Shadows of the Empire ROM, dumped from your cartridge. The builder contains nothing of the game.
features: **Native, not emulated:** SotE-Recomp turns the game's own code into code for the phone, and [RT64](https://github.com/rt64/rt64) draws it with Metal.

**Touch controls** like the other ports: a stick appears where your left thumb lands, and you drag anywhere else to look. **Modern** controls (move and strafe, look separately) by default, or the N64's **Classic** turn-and-walk.
**Gyro aiming:** off, while touching, or always, with SENS for look speed (1x to 4x).
**A photo camera:** tap for a photo, slide sideways for a burst. Photos go straight to your Photos app.
**A cheat:** infinite health, lives, ammo, missiles and vehicle health, a rescue from bottomless falls (Dash is put back on the last ledge he stood on), and LEVEL SELECT.
**A start card:** CONTINUE goes straight back into the game as your last player.
**Menus by touch:** tap a row to pick it, swipe for the D-pad.
**Game controllers** work too.
sorry: This is an unofficial fan project and a beta, so please expect bugs. It plays on an iPhone, but iPads and older iPhones haven't been tried. Holding CAMERA for selfies, Action Freeze (slide down) and the cinematic burst (slide up) are still being worked on: the view can land in the wrong place, show copies of Dash, or come out one flat colour. Now and then the screen can flash one colour for a frame. There's no multiplayer to worry about: it's a single-player game. Sorry about the rough edges. If something goes wrong, please [open an issue here](https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/sote-ios/issues), not at SotE-Recomp, and attach sote-log.txt from Files > SotE.
thanks: **[GTTeancum](https://github.com/GTTeancum)**, who made [SotE-Recomp](https://github.com/GTTeancum/SotE-Recomp), the PC port of Shadows of the Empire this is built on. When asked, GTTeancum opened its code to everyone under the MIT licence and welcomed ports like this one. Its game code, menus, modern controls and cheats are what this app runs. Thank you!

**Wiseguy ([Mr-Wiseguy](https://github.com/Mr-Wiseguy)) and the contributors** of [N64Recomp](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp) and [N64ModernRuntime](https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64ModernRuntime), the recompiler and runtime that make native ports of N64 games possible.

**Darío ([DarioSamo](https://github.com/DarioSamo)), Wiseguy and the contributors** of [RT64](https://github.com/rt64/rt64) and its graphics layer [plume](https://github.com/renderbag/plume), which draw the game.
The **[SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL)** team, for sound and controllers.
**LucasArts**, for making Shadows of the Empire.
